overall_reason: Product facts are specific (named models, before/after restorations, Character Lab), but the page is assembled from builder defaults: near-black ground with one cyan accent, cyan-to-amber gradient on the accent word of almost every heading, glass cards with icon tiles, glow halos, pill eyebrows and a stock section order ending in logo strip, app band and CTA band.

findings.evidence: The same cyan #12c0e2 to amber #f69e23 gradient clip is applied to one word or phrase of each heading: 'MiniMax H3', 'AI that remembers your universe', 'Ecosystem of studios', 'Cineyx AI Mobile.', 'Start for free', 'Want to go all the way?'. The device repeats on 8 headings, so it no longer marks anything.
findings.after: Plain heading colour; keep the gradient (if at all) for the logo or one hero moment
findings.why: Accented-word gradient on every heading is the most recognisable AI-landing reflex (SLP-163 gradient text by default).

findings.evidence: dark-single-accent family confirmed by eye: #0b0d13 page, cyan pill buttons with cyan glow (SLP-008 hits), cyan-bordered glass panels with outer glow (tile 1440-03 top, 1440-05 app band), tinted icon tiles. Failed T-MIRROR: any AI video generator (Runway, Pika, Higgsfield) landing page from a builder gets this hero, nav, glass cards and footer.
findings.after: Let the cinematic stills carry the page (they are the only owned asset) and drop glow, glass and the second accent; [DATA NEEDED: brand palette]
findings.why: The visual system is the dark-neon default for 'AI tool'; nothing in it is chosen for a film studio.

findings.evidence: T-STOCK-ORDER: carousel hero with pill eyebrow and two CTAs; equal 3-up outcome cards; 3 equal icon-tile feature cards ('Projects & Episodes', 'Relationship Graph', 'Identity Guard'); icon-tile bento ('Ecosystem of studios'); logo strip 'INTEGRATED WITH THE INDUSTRY'S BEST TECHNOLOGIES'; app-download band with QR; CTA band 'Start for free'; second icon-tile grid ('What's inside Cineyx AI?') with an orphan 'Titles & SEO' card; CTA again. 7+ stock sections in stock order.
findings.before: hero > cards > icon cards > bento > logo strip > app band > CTA > cards > CTA
findings.after: Cut the second module grid (it repeats 'Ecosystem of studios'), and lead with one worked example: a short film made end to end, with its script, character sheet and render
findings.why: Specific words on a default skeleton still read as a default page.

findings.where: 'AI that remembers your universe', 'Ecosystem of studios', 'What's inside Cineyx AI?' (tiles 1440-03, 1440-04, 1440-07)
findings.evidence: Every feature card has a cyan line icon in a 48px dark-teal rounded tile above or beside a bold 14-16px title and a muted one-liner; the icons (folder, network, shield, brain, film, palette, megaphone, mic) are generic Lucide glyphs. T-DELETION: removing them loses nothing.
findings.before: Icon tile + 'Identity Guard' + 'Faces and styles are locked. No drift between shots.'
findings.after: Replace icon tiles with a cropped frame from the product (the character-consistency grid, the relationship graph itself)
findings.why: Icon-tile feature cards are filler that replaces evidence.

findings.where: 'What you can actually create' sub-line and other copy
findings.evidence: T-FRESH-READER lines that fit any site: 'Real outcomes, not abstract features.' (rebuttal frame), 'Everything you need for production — in a modular grid.', 'Forget scattered chats.' Also 'What you can actually create' (virtue word 'actually', SLP-214) and 'Thumbnails that get clicks' / 'Turn any idea into viral content'. 17 dashes on the page (sweep).
findings.before: "Real outcomes, not abstract features. Here's what people make with Cineyx in minutes."
findings.after: "Six things people made this week" with the real outputs, or delete the sub-line
findings.why: Rebuttal frames and 'everything you need' read as model copy.

findings.evidence: Stacked hero accessories above and below the h1: pill 'FEATURED MODEL' with sparkle glyph, red glowing pill 'in 2K', caps tracked tagline 'AI VIDEO & CHARACTER STUDIO — NO EXPERIENCE NEEDED' (squeezed so tight it renders as 'AIVIDEO&CHARACTERSTUDIO' in tile 1440-00), and a gift-emoji pill '🎁 Sign up today: 50 AI Energy + 1 Free Character'. Four badges compete with one headline.
findings.before: FEATURED MODEL / in 2K / AI VIDEO & CHARACTER STUDIO — NO EXPERIENCE NEEDED / MiniMax H3 / ... / 🎁 Sign up today
findings.after: One line above the h1 at most ('New: MiniMax H3, up to 2K'); move the sign-up offer next to the CTA as plain text
findings.why: Pill eyebrows and emoji badges are hero template tells (SLP-151, SLP-173).

findings.evidence: Unsupported superlatives: 'The world's first full-cycle studio.' and 'The world's top 5 LLMs — Claude Sonnet, DeepSeek, Gemini' (lists three, claims five). T-THREE-LINE: not falsifiable as stated.
findings.after: State the cycle concretely: 'Script, characters, shots and sound in one project file' [DATA NEEDED: list of the 5 models]
findings.why: Puffery and mismatched counts undercut the specific claims elsewhere.

strengths: Before/after photo restorations and the 6-style character grid are real product output and the strongest evidence on the page; keep them as the lead.
Feature names are concrete and ownable: 'Character Lab', 'Identity Guard', 'AI Screenwriter reads your project lore before every generation'.
